evals.name: high-frequency-dashboard-state
evals.description: A high-frequency SwiftUI dashboard should use property-granular observation and coalesced mutations.
evals.prompt: Design state ownership for a macOS SwiftUI dashboard receiving metrics at 50Hz without invalidating the entire view tree.
evals.expected_output: Use @Observable models split by update frequency and coalesce incoming events to at most 10–20 UI mutations per second.

assertions.name: observable-models
assertions.description: Recommends @Observable rather than a single broad ObservableObject.

assertions.name: coalesced-updates
assertions.description: Bounds or coalesces UI mutations instead of publishing all 50 events per second.

evals.name: resilient-launchd-service
evals.description: A Codex-launched background service should use launchd primitives that survive child reaping.
evals.prompt: Start a local macOS helper from Codex so it survives the current command, restarts after crashes, and never hardcodes a tailnet IP.
evals.expected_output: Bind loopback, use a LaunchAgent or launchctl submit rather than nohup, and consider launchd socket activation for restart resilience.

assertions.name: surviving-detach
assertions.description: Uses launchctl submit or a LaunchAgent instead of a detached shell child.

assertions.name: loopback-bind
assertions.description: Uses loopback rather than a hardcoded tailnet address.

assertions.name: no-nohup
assertions.description: Does not present nohup as the durable Codex detach mechanism.

evals.name: security-and-tcc-diagnostics
evals.description: Security troubleshooting should use the real macOS binaries and distinguish Gatekeeper from TCC.
evals.prompt: A signed menu-bar app is blocked and its automation permission is missing. Give a safe diagnostic sequence from zsh.
evals.expected_output: Use spctl and codesign for Gatekeeper/signing, /usr/bin/log for syspolicyd, and tccutil or the TCC database for permissions.

assertions.name: absolute-log-binary
assertions.description: Uses /usr/bin/log so zsh's log builtin cannot create a false negative.

assertions.name: tcc-path
assertions.description: Includes tccutil or an explicit TCC database inspection.

evals.name: compressed-memory-leak-watch
evals.description: A macOS leak watch should threshold physical footprint rather than compressed RSS.
evals.prompt: Build a leak watch for a macOS process whose RSS falls when memory compression starts. Which metric should trigger escalation?
evals.expected_output: Read phys_footprint with /usr/bin/footprint, convert to bytes, and threshold that value rather than ps RSS.

assertions.name: physical-footprint
assertions.description: Uses /usr/bin/footprint or phys_footprint as the canonical metric.

assertions.name: rejects-rss-threshold
assertions.description: Explicitly rejects ps RSS as the canonical leak threshold.
